[IARC.12.2] **Canonical serialisation for byte-identity.** `value` is a parsed
tree (`const ds_json_t *`); the engine must serialise it with the **same**
canonical serialiser the rule `cache`-write path uses (`ds_json_serialize`)
before storing. A seeded value and a rule-written value with the same logical
JSON therefore store **byte-identically**, so a later `cached(key)` read and the
recorded-write replay path ([RARC.5.7.10]) cannot tell the two apart. The caller
retains ownership of the tree.
